source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 9 January 1987, p. 1 ("Poll victory for Mrs Seawright (result table)"); Irish News, 10 January 1987, p. 3 ("New Belfast City Councillor Mrs Elizabeth Seawright ... (result and cause of vacancy)"); Belfast Telegraph, 5 January 1987, p. 4 ("WP runner aims to better 157 poll total (pre-poll; Thursday's by-election)"); Belfast Telegraph, 5 December 1987, p. 22 ("Funeral report: Mrs Seawright 'won a Belfast City Council by-election earlier this year'")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph / Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 4,975 + 389 = 5,364 = reported valid vote; quota 2,683 = floor(5,364/2)+1. Elected on the first count. Reported turnout 24.73% exceeds valid/electorate (24.2%), so the total poll (incl. spoilt) was c. 5,475, not reported.

note: By-election of 8 January 1987 for one seat in Court (Belfast), caused by the disqualification of George Seawright (Protestant Unionist) on being jailed for nine months in October 1986 over a City Hall protest against the Secretary of State.
